subject: general
question:
The following pie-chart shows the distribution of students of graduate levels in seven different colleges. Distribution of students at graduate levels in seven different colleges:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48f83f0e34e3b06cfaac17b72c3934839ed90b984c3d2d1c43d75ac14d975598.png] 

What is the sum of students in College of P and T studying at graduate level?
solution:
**Given:**

Total number of students = 32500 

**Concept used:**

100% = Total number of students 

**Calculation:**

Here, the total number of students = 32500 

So, 100% = 32500 

⇒ 1% = 325 

Students in College (P) = 12% and College (T) = 18% 

Students of college (P) and (T) = 12% + 18% = 30% 

⇒ 30% × 325 = (30)/(100) × 100 = 9750 

Hence, the sum of students in the College of P and T studying at the graduate level is 9750.
